title: 현재 사용중인 컴퓨터 사양을 알고 싶어요
content: ## Question * 현재 사용중인 컴퓨터 사양을 어떻게 확인할 수 있을까요? * 컴퓨터에 이상이 없는지 어떻게 확인하나요? * 내 그래픽 카드가 무엇인지 알고 싶어요. ## Answer * 일반적으로 잘 알려진 방법은 내 컴퓨터 > 우클릭 메뉴 > 속성을 선택하는 것입니다. * '**컴퓨터에 대한 기본 정보 보기** ' 화면에서는 CPU, 메모리, Windows 버전을 쉽게 확인할 수 있습니다. * 그래픽카드 정보, 자가 진단과 같은 자세한 정보는 아래에서 확인하세요. ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360056607314) \-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ## Windows 사용자 * 내 컴퓨터 > 속성 * 시스템 정보 (msinfo32) * 바탕화면 우클릭 > Nvidia 제어판 > 속성 * DirectX 진단 도구 * 써드파티 프로그램 사용 ## Mac 사용자 * [이 Mac에 관하여](https://support.apple.com/ko-kr/HT201260) * About this Mac ## 같이 보기 * CLO 컴퓨터 권장사양 * 최적의 그래픽카드 선택 * 그래픽카드 드라이버 설치하기
content_description: 이 웹 페이지는 사용자가 자신의 컴퓨터 사양을 확인하고, 이상 여부를 진단하며, 그래픽 카드 정보를 쉽게 얻을 수 있도록 안내합니다.

content: **List of Contents** Layer Set Layer **Layer** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jSKSGF9r-dI \- Set the order of Layers to easily simulate layered 3D Garments. \- Navigate to the Property Editor ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ **Layer.** ** ****Set Layer** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0iDh933y9M0 \- Using the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022754007/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool, select the Pattern to be edited. \- Navigate to the Property Editor ▶ Simulation Properties ▶ **Layer.** \- Type in the value for the Layer option. title: Subsurface Scattering Material
content: **Objective** Realistically express human skin. Subsurface Scattering Material penetrates and scatters under the objects' surface. Utilize the material to illustrate leaves, fruit, candles and more. Application results are only be viewed in the [Render ](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115014784747-Run-V-Ray-Render)window. [Watch Tutorial Video](https://youtu.be/myqp2Li8FiI) **Location** Fabric Property Editor ▶ Material ▶ Type ▶ **Skin (Render Only)** ** Operation** 1. Select the menu/tool indicated.** ****** 2. Refer to the table below to edit the properties. **Properties** | **Description** ---|--- **Mix** | Adjust the value of Subsurface Scattering (in which light is scattered by penetrating objects). If the value is 0, the material is not applied and is reflected only on the surface of the object. If the value is 1, it is applied to the maximum extent and does not reflect on the surface of the object. **Mix Map**(ver 7.1) | Apply a Mix Map to partially apply the amount of subsurface scattering. **Density Scale** | Adjust the size property of an object to adjust the extent to which SSS is applied. The smaller the value, the wider the SSS coverage. **※ Note:** The Density Scale is applied by multiplying/sharing of each layer radius value, so adjust only the size to which SSS is applied while maintaining the radius ratio between the three layers. **Shallow / Medium / Deep ** | Adjust the properties of the three layers of subsurface scattering to express composite materials. Color | Set the color of the light to be scattered. Color Map | Use a map to express the desired color in the desired area. Weight | The weight of the layer sets the intensity of the color and map of the layer that is set against the other layer. If the value is 1, it has the highest weight. Radius | Set the radius in which each layer scatters inside the surface of the object. 3. Start the [Render](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/ko/articles/115014784747-V-Ray-%EB%A0%8C%EB%8D%94-%EC%8B%A4%ED%96%89) window. → Subsurface Scattering Material materials are applied. **※ Note:** When two or more meshes are overlapped, SSS materials can appear abnormally. Therefore, take the overlapped meshes off each other using other 3D programs, or import the meshes separately and apply SSS materials. ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360097836353/mceclip0.png)
content_description: Discover how to realistically create and apply Subsurface Scattering Materials to enhance the visual authenticity of human skin and various objects in your 3D renders.

Follow the indicated guideline below: Load OBJ as Trim ▶ ![scale_gizmo.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024298848/scale_gizmo.png) **Scale** → The **Scale Gizmo** appears. 3. Click and drag on the x,y, or z-axis to transform the OBJ. **Axis** | **Description** ---|--- **X-Axis** | The red axis of the Gizmo. Click and drag the x-axis to transform the OBJ trim along its x-axis. **Y-Axis** | The yellow-green axis of the Gizmo. Click and drag the y-axis to transform the OBJ trim along its y-axis. **Z-Axis** | The blue axis of the Gizmo. Click and drag the z-axis to transform the OBJ along its z-axis. **Square** | The yellow square located in the center of the **Scale Gizmo**. Click and drag the square to transform the OBJ trim, while maintaining its x, y, and z ratio. → The OBJ is transformed. 4. When the OBJ transformation is complete, click the ![scale_gizmo.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024298848/scale_gizmo.png) **Scale** button again. → The **Gizmo** used for moving and rotating OBJs appears. **Via the Property Editor ** 1. [Load an OBJ](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000494107). 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 3D Garment ▶ **Select/Move ** 3D Toolbar**▶![Toolbar_3D_Select_Move.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024215067/Toolbar_3D_Select_Move.png) Select/Move ** 3. Select the OBJ to be transformed. → The properties of the OBJ appear in the Property Editor. 4. Find the **Scale** option. 5. Enter the desired value for below options. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **X-Axis** | Enter the desired x-axis value. **Y-Axis** | Enter the desired y-axis value. **Z-Axis** | Enter the desired z-axis value. **Maintain Ratio** | Toggle this option on to adjust an OBJ while maintaining its x, y, and z ratio. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide on transforming OBJ files using the Scale Gizmo and Property Editor in Clo3D.

title: Strengthen
content: **List of Contents** Strengthen Result of Strengthen **Strengthen** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZCWi0Vffau4 \- Temporarily harden Patterns while simulating the 3D Garment. \- Strengthen when folding or straightening Patterns in the 3D window. \- Use the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022739767/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool to select patterns, right click, and select **Strengthen. ** Windows Shortcut: Ctrl + H Mac Shortcut: Ctrl + L (ver5.0.0)** ** ** Result of Strengthen** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zwhNz339xlo \- When the Patterns are strengthened properly, they turn orange. \- The Patterns will temporarily gain strength and express clean folds where fold angles are applied. \- To unstrengthen the Pattern, use the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022739767/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool to select Pattern, right click, and select **Unstrengthen. ** Windows Shortcut: Ctrl + H Mac Shortcut: Ctrl + L (ver5.0.0) Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on the "Strengthen" feature in 3D garment simulation, including instructional videos and step-by-step methods to temporarily enhance pattern strength for improved folding and styling.

title: Video Capture 3D Garment (Turntable)
content: **List of Contents** Record Quit **Objective** Easily record 3D garments with Turntable, utilize it when communicating. YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ko3ssVpNffQ ** Location** **Record** Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Video Capture ▶ **Turntable** **Quit** X button on the top-right corner of Turntable dialogue ▶ **X Button** ** Operation** **Record** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated in Location. → Turntable dialogue window appears at the bottom-right corner. 2. Set options as needed and start recording. ** Video Size ** | Adjust the orientation, width and height of the turntable video window. ---|--- ** Options ** | Rotation Axis (ver 6.1) | Set the rotation axis of a Turntable video. Auto | The axis is set to the center of the garment and avatar in the 3D window. Center (0.0) | The axis is set to the center (0.0) in the 3D window. Custom | Enter the desired value of the X and Z-axis to set the desired axis. Direction | Set the direction (clockwise/ counter-clockwise) of the turntable. Duration | Set the duration of the turntable video. Minimum of 1 second and a maximum of 60 seconds. Save HTML File | The turntable is saved as HTML. ** Video Codec ** | Set the codec to use when recording video. **※ Note: **it is available to save MP4/AVI for Windows and MOV files for MAC without installing a separate codec. ** Record ** | ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005767708/capture_01rec_on.png) / ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005767728/capture_01rec_refresh_on.png) | Start or delete the recording and return to the initial state. **Quit** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated in Location. →**** Recording stops and the dialogue window disappears. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for recording 3D garments using a Turntable, facilitating effective communication through visual representations.

title: [2D Tool] M:N Free Sewing
content: **Objective** Freely establish Sewing Lines on Pattern outlines and Internal Shapes/Lines to sew multiple Patterns (M) to multiple Patterns (N) at once. ** Location** Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ **M:N Free Sewing** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005448927/M_N________.png) **M:N Free Sewing** **※ Note:** Hold down the **Free Sewing** tool for a while to access the **M:N Free Sewing** Tool. ** Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ **M:N Free Sewing** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005448927/M_N________.png) **M:N Free Sewing** 2. Establish Free Sewing Lines on multiple Patterns, which are considered as M Patterns. 3. Hit the Enter key on the keyboard to complete. → The Sewing Lines appear in neon color. 4. While being mindful of Directional Notches, establish Sewing Lines on Patterns which are sewn to M Patterns. Hit the Enter key on the keyboard to complete M:N Sewing Lines. → All Sewing Lines no longer appear in neon color. **※ Note:** * While establishing the Sewing Lines, hit the Delete key on the keyboard to cancel the last action or hit the Esc key on the keyboard to cancel all actions. * While establishing M:N sewing lines, if you click on an inappropriate segment, the segment appears in red and the Sewing Line cannot be applied. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide for using the M:N Free Sewing tool to efficiently establish sewing lines on multiple patterns simultaneously within the sewing interface.

title: [Popup] Delete Sewing
content: ### **Objective** Delete unnecessary Sewing Lines. ** Location** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001219307/________.png) **Edit Sewing** Tool ▶ Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Sewing Line) ▶ **Delete Sewing** ** Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: 2D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001219307/________.png) **Edit Sewing** Tool ▶ Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Sewing Line) ▶ **Delete Sewing** **※ Note:** You can also delete the Sewing Line by select ▶ hit the Delete key on the keyboard.
content_description: Learn how to efficiently delete unnecessary sewing lines using the Edit Sewing tool in the 2D Toolbar.

title: Delete Avatar
content: ### **Objective** Select avatar and delete individually. **※ Note:** Versions below ver2.5.0 only allow avatar deletion for all. ** Location** Main Menu ▶ Avatar ▶ **Delete Avatar** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005761848/Toolbar_3D_Select_Move.png) Select/Move ▶ Pop-up Menu (Right-click on Avatar) ▶ **Delete Avatar** ** Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Avatar ▶ **Delete Avatar** 3D Toolbar ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005761848/Toolbar_3D_Select_Move.png) Select/Move ▶ Pop-up Menu (Right-click on Avatar) ▶ **Delete Avatar** → The avatar is now being deleted. **※ Note:** From ver2.5.0, deleted avatars can immediately be restored at Main Menu ▶ Edit ▶**Undo or Press (Ctrl+Z)**
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for selecting and deleting avatars in Clo3D, with specific instructions for users on versions below and above 2.5.0.
